h:
此工作流程包括样式扩展，可将 70 多种新样式提示添加到 SDXL Prompt Styler 样式选择器菜单中。

要使此样式扩展工作流程正常工作，您需要安装“SDXL Prompt Styler”：https://github.com/twri/sdxl_prompt_styler

我还强烈推荐“ComfyUI-Manager”：https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager.git如果您缺少任何节点，它会让您知道缺少哪些节点，并为您提供缺少节点的快速一键安装选项。

此工作流程和随附的 JSON 文件向 SDXL Prompt Styler 菜单添加了 70 多种视觉样式和艺术样式。我对不同的艺术风格进行了一些研究，才知道如何提示每种风格，我学到了很多东西。它们并不完美，因为许多样式对我来说都是新的，我必须根据样式的描述对如何为其构建提示脚本做出有根据的猜测。所以它们可能不是 100% 忠实于风格，但它们确实增加了相当多的艺术多样性！

这个扩展及其 70 多种视觉样式（以及修改它的工作流程）花了几个小时来编译和创建，所以如果您有时间请留下评分为此。我将非常感激！ :)

如果您喜欢这个或从中获得一些创意乐趣，请考虑捐赠：https://ko-fi.com/divaai这确实有助于激励我继续为你们创造新内容。

~ 女主角

o.en:
This workflow includes a Styles Expansion that adds over 70 new style prompts to the SDXL Prompt Styler style selector menu.

For this Styles Expansion workflow to work you need to have "SDXL Prompt Styler" installed:https://github.com/twri/sdxl_prompt_styler

I also highly recommend the "ComfyUI-Manager":https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager.gitIf you're missing any nodes it will let you know which ones you're missing and will give you a quick one-click install option for the missing nodes.

This workflow and the included JSON file adds 70+ visual styles and art styles to the SDXL Prompt Styler menu. It took some research on the different art styles to know how to prompt for each style and I learned a lot. They're not perfect, as many styles are new to me and I had to make educated guesses based on the style's descriptions on how to build the prompt scripts for them. So they might not be 100% true to the styles, but they do add a nice amount of artistic variety!

This expansion and it's 70+ visual styles (as well as modifying a workflow for it) took a few hours to compile and create, soif you have a minute please leave a ratingfor this. I'd very much appreciate it! :)

If you enjoy this or get some creative fun out of it please consider donating:https://ko-fi.com/divaaiIt would really help to motivate me to keep creating new content for you guys.

~ Diva
